_readme: Shared interface-contract fixture for the pin_weight_pct units convention. Every UI (Web's ReviewStep slider, Android's TruckTagEntryScreen slider) works in whole percentage points (15-25, default 20) since that's what a person reads off a physical slider. compute_breakdown/computeBreakdown always work in the equivalent 0.15-0.25 fraction. Each UI's own thin conversion layer (Web's createBreakdown in breakdown.ts, Android's RigCheckViewModel) is the one place that divides by 100 before the math runs - a change to that line, on either platform, is the exact silently-wrong-math risk this fixture exists to catch. Consumed by web/src/breakdown.test.ts's pin-weight conversion case - if this file's values ever change, update it.
